description.value: Magical arrays added to your pawns' internal compartments have made them larger on the inside than on the outside. The compartment granted by Extra Space gains the properties of a spacious pouch, except that it can hold only up to 5 Bulk of items. Stored items have no size limits. If a pawn with Extra Space installed becomes overloaded or is destroyed, its internal space is ruined, and the items inside are lost forever.
